Name: Rangerkatt's Pigeons and Doves for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Rangerkatt gave me permission to update their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2513]Pigeons and Doves[/url] for 1.6 so here they are :)

Pigeons and doves can be found at Marnie's. They drop pigeon and dove eggs that can be hatched or turned into mayo, and doves drop olive branches at higher friendship levels, which are a loved gift by everyone.

This mod is technically compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43365]Pigeons Plus Revived[/url] but I did reuse my own egg and mayo art assets so there might be some confusion to the player. Game will handle it just fine though :)

Enjoy!
